name: Confectioner's Ink
description: Draw permanent ink chutes to sort falling sugar through colour gates and a recolouring hot plate.
natural_language: Draw solid ink chutes to fill each jar with its own colour. The hopper keeps pouring. Ink is permanent; wrong colours and spilled grains are wasted. The hot plate recolours grains that touch it.

metadata.notes: Original draw-to-route particle simulation; outcome independently replayed from timed ink geometry. Script evidence is not human calibration.
